insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Noggin Boss grew total sales to $379 in Week 46, up 65.2% from $229 the prior week, on 5 units. The Plain Grey Crazy Party Hat led the lineup at $79 with an 11.1% conversion rate on 9 sessions (+28.6%), and the Powder Blue, Royal and Maroon oversized hats each added $74. Sunday, Nov 8 was the peak day at $229.

**Metrics to Watch —** Sales came in on three days (Sun Nov 8 $229, Thu Nov 12 $74, Sat Nov 14 $74), so steadier day-to-day volume is the next step. Organic sales were $0 (-100.0% WoW) because ads drove all $379 this week, which shows paid traffic is converting while organic ranking builds. We are focused on turning that ad-driven demand into organic visibility for the top hats.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $210 (prior $15) returned $379 in PPC revenue for a 1.81x ROAS, up from 0.00x, with ACOS and TACoS both at 55.4%. Ads converted at 2.35% on a 0.37% ad CTR, and we are now tightening targeting to bring ACOS down while keeping the sales momentum.

**Actions This Week —** We will move budget toward the hats that converted best, the Plain Grey Party Hat at 11.1% CVR and the Royal oversized hat at 7.7%, and add negative keywords on clicks that did not convert. We will also test new Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands ad creative to lift the 0.37% ad CTR heading into the holiday season.
